facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 67°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

lines.label: Road
lines.text: Traditionally weather and road conditions are reported on this page from November 1 to April 1. Should adverse weather occur that will impact travel, updates will be provided as information is available.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 19 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Trough
evidence.detail: left April 10; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 11 (2024), May 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Grouse Camp
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 10 (2023), May 5 (2024), May 1 (2025)

evidence.name: Upper Wheeler
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 12 (2023), May 8 (2024), April 29 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Trough
evidence.detail: 3.5 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 17.4 in (2023), 11.7 in (2024), 12.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Grouse Camp
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 20.5 in (2023), 13.6 in (2024), 15.0 in (2025)

evidence.name: Upper Wheeler
evidence.detail: 4.9 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 13.9 in (2023), 10.1 in (2024), 9.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 15 and April 24, carried from the melt-out date at Upper Wheeler (4,330 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Upper Wheeler
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 1,658 ft above the pass; points to February 15 to April 24
